sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 60. Heals HP.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies 30% elevation for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: your character. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 50 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases Unison gauge gains for all allies by 2 for 50 seconds.
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +80
Only [Celestial] Airi can be used as Unlocking Potential material
